hints.title: Sliding Window Stream Aggregation
hints.text: A continuous stream of integers must maintain the average of the most recent size values. How can an incremental rolling sum eliminate recomputing the entire window?

hints.title: Circular Buffer or Double-Ended Collection
hints.text: Maintain an internal buffer and a running window sum variable. When the buffer size reaches window capacity, subtract the exiting oldest value from the sum before appending the newest.

hints.title: Constant-Time Rolling Mean Formula
hints.text: Add incoming val to running sum, append val to buffer. If buffer count exceeds capacity, pop the oldest value and subtract it from sum. Return running sum divided by buffer length.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Maintains running sum and slides window in constant time per incoming value.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-summing the window on every incoming data point costs O(W) per call, scaling poorly under high-throughput streaming.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bounded memory buffer of size W prevents memory leaks over unbounded streaming input.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of double precision floating point division and correct initialization before window is full.
